# Secure Password Generator — Fast & Random Client-Side Passwords

> Secure Password Generator is a privacy-first browser tool to generate cryptographically strong random passwords and memorable multi-word passphrases with real-time entropy calculation.

Website: https://password-generator.corelumetech.in/
Developer & Publisher: Corelume Tech (https://corelumetech.in)
Privacy Policy: 100% Client-Side Processing. No user data, files, or strings are collected, stored, or transmitted to any server.

## Overview
Secure Password Generator is a privacy-first browser tool to generate cryptographically strong random passwords and memorable multi-word passphrases with real-time entropy calculation.

## Core Features
- Cryptographically secure random password generation (using Web Crypto API)
- Memorable Passphrase Generator mode with customizable word separators
- Ambiguous character filter (excludes confusing characters like i, l, 1, L, o, 0, O)
- Real-time Password Strength and Entropy meter with color-coded rating
- Fine-grained parameter controls: uppercase, lowercase, numbers, and custom symbols
- Instant copy-to-clipboard with auto-clearing feedback

## Benchmarks & Technical Specifications
- Uses window.crypto.getRandomValues for cryptographically secure pseudo-random numbers (CSPRNG)
- Supports passwords from 6 to 128 characters and multi-word passphrases
- Calculates up to 128+ bits of entropy for maximum brute-force resistance
- 0% data transmission — passwords are never sent across any network
